subject: ManifestHeader 128 freeze
body:

CONFLICT reason is DISTINCT_VERIFIED_REFS 0x30. Informal INCOMPLETE in 03.6 is now SEARCH_INCOMPLETE. GEMINI xref is 01.8.
00_INDEX 128-vs-132 open note is stale vs live 04.6. A-owned; B will not edit 00_INDEX.
